apple_scab.symptoms: Olive-green to brown velvety spots on leaves and fruit. Affected leaves may turn yellow and drop prematurely.
apple_scab.treatment: Apply Captan (2g/L) or Mancozeb (2.5g/L) at pink bud stage. Prune infected branches to improve airflow.
apple_scab.prevention: Rake and burn fallen leaves in autumn. Plant scab-resistant apple cultivars like Liberty or Enterprise.
apple_scab.biological: Spray neem oil or Bacillus subtilis strain QST 713 at early leaf unfolding.

apple_black_rot.symptoms: Small purple spots on leaves expanding into 'frog-eye' lesions with brown centers and purple margins.
apple_black_rot.treatment: Spray Thiophanate-methyl (1g/L) or Copper Hydroxide (2g/L). Prune dead wood and mummified fruit.
apple_black_rot.prevention: Remove mummified apples from trees. Maintain healthy trees through proper fertilization and watering.
apple_black_rot.biological: Apply Trichoderma harzianum soil drench and canopy spray.

apple_cedar_rust.symptoms: Bright yellow-orange spots on upper leaf surfaces; tube-like spore structures on leaf underside.
apple_cedar_rust.treatment: Apply Myclobutanil (0.5g/L) or Propiconazole (1ml/L) from blossom open through petal fall.
apple_cedar_rust.prevention: Remove nearby eastern red cedar trees within 1-2 miles if feasible. Plant resistant varieties.
apple_cedar_rust.biological: Sulfur-based fungicides applied before symptom emergence.

apple_healthy.cause: Optimal orchard management and disease protection.
apple_healthy.symptoms: Vibrant green leaf tissue with no visual lesions, rust spots, or fungal growth.
apple_healthy.treatment: Continue regular monitoring and balanced fertilization.
apple_healthy.prevention: Maintain proper sanitation, spacing, and pruning routines.

blueberry_healthy.symptoms: Deep green foliage without chlorosis, spots, or tip burn.
blueberry_healthy.treatment: Maintain soil pH with elemental sulfur. Mulch with pine bark.
blueberry_healthy.prevention: Avoid waterlogging; ensure acid-rich organic matter.

cherry_powdery_mildew.symptoms: White powdery fungal growth on leaves causing leaf curling and distorted growth.
cherry_powdery_mildew.treatment: Spray Potassium Bicarbonate (3g/L) or Myclobutanil (0.5ml/L) at first sign.
cherry_powdery_mildew.prevention: Improve orchard canopy air circulation. Avoid high nitrogen late-season fertilizer.
cherry_powdery_mildew.biological: Spray neem seed oil (5ml/L) or Bacillus amyloliquefaciens.

cherry_healthy.cause: Good canopy management and soil health.
cherry_healthy.symptoms: Uniform green leaf blade with intact margins and no mildew spots.

corn_gray_leaf_spot.symptoms: Rectangular tan-to-gray lesions restricted by leaf veins running parallel.
corn_gray_leaf_spot.treatment: Apply Azoxystrobin + Difenoconazole (1ml/L) at VT-R1 tassel stage if disease pressure is high.
corn_gray_leaf_spot.prevention: Rotate crops with non-host plants (soybean). Tillage to decompose crop residue.
corn_gray_leaf_spot.biological: Bio-control using Trichoderma viride seed treatment.

corn_common_rust.symptoms: Small golden-brown to cinnamon-brown pustules scattered over upper and lower leaf surfaces.
corn_common_rust.treatment: Foliar fungicide spray with Pyraclostrobin (1ml/L) if rust appears before silking.
corn_common_rust.prevention: Plant resistant hybrid seed cultivars. Avoid late planting dates.

corn_northern_leaf_blight.symptoms: Long cigar-shaped grayish-green to tan lesions on leaves.
corn_northern_leaf_blight.treatment: Spray Mancozeb (2.5g/L) or Propiconazole (1ml/L) when lower leaf lesions reach 5%.
corn_northern_leaf_blight.prevention: Use resistant corn hybrids (Ht genes). Rotate out of corn for 1-2 seasons.
corn_northern_leaf_blight.biological: Bacillus subtilis root and leaf sprays.

corn_healthy.cause: Balanced NPK fertility and good moisture management.
corn_healthy.symptoms: Lush dark green leaves without rust pustules or blight streaks.
corn_healthy.prevention: Ensure proper field drainage and crop rotation.

grape_black_rot.symptoms: Reddish-brown circular leaf spots with tiny black dots (pycnidia) arranged in rings.
grape_black_rot.treatment: Spray Myclobutanil or Mancozeb starting from bud break at 10-14 day intervals.
grape_black_rot.prevention: Prune out mummified berries and dead canes during winter.
grape_black_rot.biological: Copper hydroxide combined with sulfur dust.

grape_esca.symptoms: 'Tiger-stripe' chlorotic and necrotic discoloration between leaf veins.
grape_esca.treatment: No cure for infected wood; paint pruning wounds with wound sealant containing fungicide.
grape_esca.prevention: Avoid pruning during wet weather. Sanitize shears with 70% alcohol.
grape_esca.biological: Trichoderma species application to pruning wounds.

grape_leaf_blight.symptoms: Irregular dark brown leaf spots with dull green/yellow haloes leading to premature defoliation.
grape_leaf_blight.treatment: Spray Carbendazim (1g/L) or Copper Oxychloride (3g/L) after harvest and pre-monsoon.
grape_leaf_blight.prevention: Ensure good trellis canopy ventilation and weed clearance.

grape_healthy.cause: Optimal vineyard canopy management and dry microclimate.
grape_healthy.symptoms: Intact green leaf blade free from tiger-striping or black rot dots.
grape_healthy.treatment: Maintain trellis training and canopy shoot thinning.
grape_healthy.prevention: Monitor humidity and apply preventive copper sprays when needed.

citrus_huanglongbing.cause: Candidatus Liberibacter asiaticus (Bacterium transmitted by Asian Citrus Psyllid)
citrus_huanglongbing.symptoms: Asymmetrical blotchy mottle on leaves, yellow shoots, small misshapen bitter fruit.
citrus_huanglongbing.treatment: No cure for HLB. Control vector Asian Citrus Psyllid using Imidacloprid or Thiamethoxam.
citrus_huanglongbing.prevention: Plant certified disease-free nursery stock. Remove severely infected trees immediately.
citrus_huanglongbing.biological: Release Tamarixia radiata parasitoid wasps to reduce psyllid populations.

peach_bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small water-soaked leaf spots turning dark purple/black, dropping out to give 'shot-hole' appearance.
peach_bacterial_spot.treatment: Spray Oxytetracycline or Copper Hydroxide at low rates during shuck split.
peach_bacterial_spot.prevention: Avoid excessive nitrogen fertilization. Plant resistant peach varieties.
peach_bacterial_spot.biological: Bacteriophage sprays or Bacillus subtilis formulations.

peach_healthy.symptoms: Smooth lance-shaped green leaves without shot-holes or bacterial spots.
peach_healthy.treatment: Maintain balanced potassium and zinc micro-nutrients.

pepper_bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small, water-soaked brown spots on leaves with yellow halos, causing premature leaf drop.
pepper_bacterial_spot.treatment: Spray Copper Hydroxide (2g/L) mixed with Mancozeb (2.5g/L) to overcome copper resistance.
pepper_bacterial_spot.prevention: Use certified disease-free seeds. Avoid overhead irrigation and handling wet plants.
pepper_bacterial_spot.biological: Foliar application of Bacillus subtilis or Pseudomonas fluorescens.

pepper_leaf_spot.symptoms: Circular spots with light brown/white centers and dark brown borders on leaves.
pepper_leaf_spot.treatment: Spray Chlorothalonil (2g/L) or Copper Oxychloride (3g/L) at 10-day intervals.
pepper_leaf_spot.prevention: Rotate crops every 2 years. Destroy crop residue post-harvest.
pepper_leaf_spot.biological: Neem cake soil application and bio-fungicide sprays.

pepper_cercospora.symptoms: Frog-eye spots with grayish-white centers and dark red-brown borders on leaves and stems.
pepper_cercospora.prevention: Mulch soil to eliminate rain splash. Spacing plants for rapid leaf drying.

pepper_leaf_curl.cause: Chilli leaf curl virus (transmitted by Whiteflies)
pepper_leaf_curl.symptoms: Upward curling of leaves, puckering, reduced leaf size, stunting of plants.
pepper_leaf_curl.treatment: Control vector Whiteflies using Imidacloprid (0.5ml/L) or Acetamiprid (0.2g/L).
pepper_leaf_curl.prevention: Use yellow sticky traps (10-12/acre). Install 40-mesh insect-proof netting in nurseries.
pepper_leaf_curl.biological: Spray Neem oil 10,000 ppm (3ml/L) or Verticillium lecanii.

pepper_phytophthora_blight.symptoms: Dark green water-soaked spots rapidly expanding into dull brown necrotic foliar lesions.
pepper_phytophthora_blight.treatment: Drench and spray Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (2g/L) or Potassium Phosphonate (3ml/L).
pepper_phytophthora_blight.prevention: Improve field drainage, raise planting beds, avoid standing water.
pepper_phytophthora_blight.biological: Soil drenching with Trichoderma viride fortified organic compost.

pepper_yellowing.symptoms: Generalized yellowing of lower or upper leaves between leaf veins.
pepper_yellowing.treatment: Apply Magnesium Sulfate (5g/L) foliar spray and balanced NPK 19-19-19.
pepper_yellowing.prevention: Regular soil testing and balanced fertigation.
pepper_yellowing.biological: Pentanick organic amino acid and sea-weed extract spray.

pepper_healthy.cause: Optimal soil nutrients, moisture control, and pest exclusion.
pepper_healthy.symptoms: Lush dark green leaves without curling, yellowing spots, or water-soaked lesions.
pepper_healthy.treatment: Maintain balanced NPK fertigation and routine pest scouting.
pepper_healthy.prevention: Ensure good drainage and yellow sticky traps for vector control.

potato_early_blight.symptoms: Concentric rings (target board pattern) on older lower leaves, surrounded by a yellow halo.
potato_early_blight.treatment: Spray Mancozeb (2.5g/L) or Chlorothalonil (2g/L) upon initial detection.
potato_early_blight.prevention: Destroy crop debris after harvest. Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation.
potato_early_blight.biological: Bacillus subtilis or Trichoderma viride applications.

potato_late_blight.symptoms: Water-soaked dark lesions on leaf tips and margins; white mildew fuzzy growth on underside in humid weather.
potato_late_blight.treatment: Spray Cymoxanil + Mancozeb (2g/L) or Dimethomorph (1g/L) immediately.
potato_late_blight.prevention: Use certified seed tubers. Destroy volunteer potato plants.
potato_late_blight.biological: Copper oxychloride + Neem oil combination spray.

potato_healthy.cause: Proper hilling, clean seeds, and moisture management.
potato_healthy.symptoms: Uniform compound green leaves with crisp margins and no water-soaked blights.
potato_healthy.treatment: Continue scheduled hilling and balanced fertilization.

raspberry_healthy.cause: Good cane pruning and soil organic matter.
raspberry_healthy.symptoms: Vibrant serrated green leaves with no rust or spot lesions.
raspberry_healthy.treatment: Routine cane pruning and weed control.
raspberry_healthy.prevention: Maintain air movement through cane rows.

soybean_healthy.cause: Effective Rhizobium nodulation and pest control.
soybean_healthy.symptoms: Trifoliate deep green leaves free from rust pustules or bacterial pustules.
soybean_healthy.prevention: Crop rotation with corn or small grains.

squash_powdery_mildew.symptoms: White talcum-like powdery spots spreading across upper leaf surfaces, leading to leaf yellowing.
squash_powdery_mildew.treatment: Spray Potassium Bicarbonate (4g/L) or Wettable Sulfur (3g/L).
squash_powdery_mildew.prevention: Plant resistant cucurbit varieties. Ensure adequate plant spacing.
squash_powdery_mildew.biological: Spray neem oil 1% solution or milk whey dilution (1:9).

strawberry_leaf_scorch.symptoms: Numerous purplish spots on leaves that enlarge and turn dark brown; leaf margins look scorched.
strawberry_leaf_scorch.treatment: Apply Captan (2g/L) or Copper Hydroxide (2g/L) early in spring.
strawberry_leaf_scorch.prevention: Renovate strawberry beds annually. Remove old infected foliage.

strawberry_healthy.cause: Clean runner planting and drip irrigation.
strawberry_healthy.symptoms: Tri-lobed shiny green leaves without purple scorch patches.
strawberry_healthy.treatment: Mulch with clean straw to protect berries and foliage.

tomato_bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small, dark brown water-soaked lesions on leaves with yellow haloes, leading to leaf drop.
tomato_bacterial_spot.treatment: Spray Copper Hydroxide (2g/L) + Mancozeb (2.5g/L) tank mix.
tomato_bacterial_spot.prevention: Use certified seed. Stake plants and apply straw mulch to prevent soil splash.

tomato_early_blight.symptoms: Concentric rings/target spots on lower leaves, surrounded by yellowing leaf tissue.
tomato_early_blight.treatment: Spray Chlorothalonil (2g/L) or Copper Hydroxide (2.5g/L). Remove lower infected leaves.
tomato_early_blight.prevention: Mulch soil to prevent rain splash. Rotate tomato crops every 3 years.
tomato_early_blight.biological: Trichoderma harzianum soil drench and Bacillus subtilis spray.

tomato_late_blight.symptoms: Large brown water-soaked patches on leaves that shrivel quickly; white downy growth on underside.
tomato_late_blight.treatment: Spray Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (2.5g/L) or Dimethomorph (1g/L) at first sign.
tomato_late_blight.prevention: Avoid late planting in cool humid seasons. Destroy infected plant refuse.

tomato_leaf_mold.symptoms: Pale green or yellow spots on upper leaf surface; olive-green to brown velvety mold underneath.
tomato_leaf_mold.prevention: Reduce greenhouse humidity below 85%. Increase ventilation and plant spacing.

tomato_septoria_leaf_spot.symptoms: Numerous small circular spots with dark brown margins and light gray centers containing black specks.
tomato_septoria_leaf_spot.treatment: Spray Chlorothalonil (2g/L) or Mancozeb (2.5g/L) at 7-10 day intervals.
tomato_septoria_leaf_spot.prevention: Prune lower branches up to 12 inches from soil. Control solanaceous weeds.
tomato_septoria_leaf_spot.biological: Copper octanoate or neem seed extract.

tomato_spider_mites.symptoms: Yellow stippling/speckling on leaves, fine silken webbing on leaf undersides, leaves turn bronze and dry up.
tomato_spider_mites.treatment: Spray Abamectin (0.5ml/L) or Spiromesifen (1ml/L). Ensure thorough underside coverage.
tomato_spider_mites.prevention: Avoid dry dusty conditions; overhead water misting can suppress mite outbreaks.
tomato_spider_mites.biological: Release predatory mites Phytoseiulus persimilis or spray Neem oil 1500 ppm.

tomato_target_spot.symptoms: Small pinpoint brown spots expanding into circular lesions with light brown centers and dark rings.
tomato_target_spot.prevention: Avoid working in fields when foliage is wet. Improve airflow around plants.

tomato_yellow_leaf_curl.cause: Tomato yellow leaf curl virus (transmitted by Bemisia tabaci whiteflies)
tomato_yellow_leaf_curl.symptoms: Severe cupping/curling of leaves, yellowing leaf margins, extreme plant stunting and flower drop.
tomato_yellow_leaf_curl.treatment: Control Whiteflies with Imidacloprid (0.5ml/L) or Thiamethoxam (0.3g/L). Remove infected plants.
tomato_yellow_leaf_curl.prevention: Use TYLCV-resistant tomato cultivars (e.g. Tyking, Shiren). Use insect mesh in greenhouses.
tomato_yellow_leaf_curl.biological: Yellow sticky cards and bio-insecticide Verticillium lecanii.

tomato_mosaic_virus.symptoms: Mottled light and dark green mosaic patterns on leaves, leaf distortion, fern-like leaf growth.
tomato_mosaic_virus.treatment: No chemical treatment available for viral infection. Remove and destroy infected plants.
tomato_mosaic_virus.prevention: Wash hands with milk or trisodium phosphate before handling plants. Sanitize pruning shears.
tomato_mosaic_virus.biological: Spray skimmed milk solution (10%) on seedlings to reduce mechanical viral transmission.

tomato_healthy.cause: Balanced fertigation, staking, and proactive IPM.
tomato_healthy.symptoms: Deep green compound leaves free from spots, target rings, or whitefly virus curling.
tomato_healthy.treatment: Maintain consistent drip irrigation to avoid blossom end rot.
tomato_healthy.prevention: Keep mulching intact and prune suckers cleanly.

coconut_bud_rot.symptoms: Rotting of the central spear leaf/spindle, yellowing and wilting of outer fronds, foul smell from crown.
coconut_bud_rot.treatment: Cut and remove infected spindle tissue. Apply 10% Bordeaux paste to cut surface. Pour 1% Bordeaux mixture into crown axils.
coconut_bud_rot.prevention: Ensure good palm spacing and crown hygiene. Avoid waterlogging around root zone.
coconut_bud_rot.biological: Apply Trichoderma harzianum coir pith cake in leaf axils before monsoon season.

coconut_gray_leaf_spot.symptoms: Small yellowish spots becoming grayish-white with dark brown borders; leaf tips dry and present scorched look.
coconut_gray_leaf_spot.treatment: Spray Copper Oxychloride (3g/L) or Mancozeb (2.5g/L) on affected fronds.
coconut_gray_leaf_spot.prevention: Ensure adequate potash (potassium) fertilization to build palm resistance.

coconut_leaf_rot.symptoms: Blackening and water-soaked rotting of leaflet distal ends, distal part of leaflets dry up and break off in wind.
coconut_leaf_rot.treatment: Pour 1% Bordeaux mixture or Contaf (Hexaconazole 2ml/L) into leaf axils after removing rotten parts.
coconut_leaf_rot.prevention: Control Rhinoceros beetle pests which create tissue entry points.
coconut_leaf_rot.biological: Apply organic neem cake (5kg/palm/year) to soil basin.

coconut_stem_bleeding.symptoms: Exudation of dark reddish-brown liquid from bark cracks on lower stem, wood beneath becomes soft and black.
coconut_stem_bleeding.treatment: Chisel out infected bark tissue up to healthy wood. Apply Coal Tar or 10% Bordeaux paste to dressed area.
coconut_stem_bleeding.prevention: Avoid physical damage to stem during harvesting. Ensure proper drainage.
coconut_stem_bleeding.biological: Apply Trichoderma viride (50g/palm) mixed with 5kg neem cake to soil basin.

coconut_bud_root_dropping.symptoms: Dropping of immature buttons and fronds, root decay and wilted crown look.
coconut_bud_root_dropping.treatment: Root feeding with Metalaxyl (2g in 100ml water) or Hexaconazole (2ml in 100ml water).
coconut_bud_root_dropping.prevention: Dig isolation trenches (1m deep) around infected palms to halt root contact spread.
coconut_bud_root_dropping.biological: Soil application of Pseudomonas fluorescens + Trichoderma mixture.

coconut_healthy.cause: Optimal palm nutrition (NPK + Magnesium), crown clearing, and basin management.
coconut_healthy.symptoms: Vibrant dark green fronds arching cleanly without leaflet blackening or spindle rot.
coconut_healthy.treatment: Apply recommended Kerala AU coconut fertilizer dose (500g N, 320g P2O5, 1200g K2O per palm/year).
coconut_healthy.prevention: Regular crown cleaning before pre-monsoon and post-monsoon.
